microtheory.name: quantum_mechanics
microtheory.definition: Quantum mechanics. Schrödinger equation, wave function, superposition, entanglement, measurement, uncertainty principle, quantum field theory. The framework for physics at atomic + subatomic scales. Foundation of chemistry, semiconductors, lasers, quantum computing. Substrate analogue: substrate's probabilistic state superposition prior to measurement-as-observation.

concepts.name: wave_function
concepts.definition: ψ(x, t). Complex-valued amplitude. |ψ|² is probability density (Born rule). Schrödinger 1926. Substrate analogue: substrate's belief amplitude.

concepts.name: schrodinger_equation
concepts.definition: iℏ ∂ψ/∂t = Ĥψ. Time evolution of quantum state under Hamiltonian. Substrate analogue: substrate's state-evolution operator.

concepts.name: hilbert_space_quantum
concepts.definition: Complex inner-product space of quantum states. State = unit vector. Operators are linear. Substrate analogue: substrate's state-vector space.

concepts.name: ket_bra_dirac
concepts.definition: Dirac notation: |ψ⟩ = ket, ⟨ψ| = bra. Inner product ⟨φ|ψ⟩ = amplitude. Substrate analogue: substrate's state notation.

concepts.name: superposition_quantum
concepts.definition: ψ = αψ₁ + βψ₂. State is linear combination of basis states. Measurement collapses to one. Substrate analogue: substrate's pre-decision distribution.

concepts.name: observable
concepts.definition: Measurable property — position, momentum, energy, spin. Hermitian operator. Eigenvalues are possible measurement outcomes. Substrate analogue: substrate's measurement variable.

concepts.name: eigenvalue_eigenstate
concepts.definition: Operator equation Â|a⟩ = a|a⟩. Eigenvalues are measurable values; eigenstates are post-measurement states. Substrate analogue: substrate's basin-state values.

concepts.name: born_rule
concepts.definition: P(outcome a) = |⟨a|ψ⟩|². Probability of measurement outcome. Substrate analogue: substrate's amplitude-squared probability.

concepts.name: wave_function_collapse
concepts.definition: Upon measurement, ψ collapses to eigenstate of measured observable. Interpretational. Substrate analogue: substrate's basin selection on observation.

concepts.name: measurement_problem
concepts.definition: Why does observation collapse superposition? Interpretations: Copenhagen, Many-Worlds (Everett), de Broglie-Bohm, GRW, QBism, Relational.

concepts.name: uncertainty_principle
concepts.definition: Heisenberg 1927. ΔxΔp ≥ ℏ/2. Non-commuting observables have fundamental joint uncertainty. Not measurement limitation — structural. Substrate analogue: substrate's complementary-information bound.

concepts.name: commutator
concepts.definition: [Â, B̂] = ÂB̂ - B̂Â. Zero ↔ simultaneously measurable. Non-zero ↔ uncertainty relation. Substrate analogue: substrate's incompatible-operations check.

concepts.name: complementarity_bohr
concepts.definition: Bohr. Wave + particle aspects mutually exclusive but jointly required for description. Substrate analogue: substrate's incompatible-frame requirement.

concepts.name: entanglement_quantum
concepts.definition: ψ_AB ≠ ψ_A ⊗ ψ_B for two-particle state. Measurement on one affects probabilities for the other instantly. EPR 1935 + Bell tests confirm. Substrate analogue: substrate's non-factorisable joint state.

concepts.name: bell_inequality
concepts.definition: Bell 1964. Classical local-realist theories satisfy inequalities QM violates. Experiments (Aspect 1982, Hensen 2015) violate Bell → local realism false. Substrate analogue: substrate's non-classical correlation.

concepts.name: no_cloning_theorem
concepts.definition: Wootters + Zurek 1982. Unknown quantum state cannot be perfectly copied. Foundation of quantum cryptography security.

concepts.name: quantum_tunneling
concepts.definition: Particle passes through energy barrier classically forbidden. Wave function nonzero on far side. Explains alpha decay, scanning tunneling microscopy.

concepts.name: spin_quantum
concepts.definition: Intrinsic angular momentum. Quantised in units of ℏ/2. Stern-Gerlach. Pauli matrices for spin-1/2. Substrate analogue: substrate's intrinsic discrete property.

concepts.name: pauli_exclusion
concepts.definition: Two identical fermions cannot share quantum state. Foundation of chemistry — electron orbitals, periodic table.

concepts.name: fermion_boson
concepts.definition: Half-integer spin (fermions, Pauli-exclusive) vs integer spin (bosons, condensable). Spin-statistics theorem.

concepts.name: quantum_field_theory
concepts.definition: QFT. Particles are excitations of underlying fields. Combines QM + special relativity. Foundation of Standard Model.

concepts.name: feynman_diagram
concepts.definition: Pictorial scheme for perturbative QFT calculations. Vertices + propagators encode amplitudes.

concepts.name: standard_model
concepts.definition: Current theory of fundamental particles + forces (electromagnetic + weak + strong). Excludes gravity. Higgs confirmed 2012.

concepts.name: quantum_computing
concepts.definition: Computation with qubits exploiting superposition + entanglement. Shor's factoring, Grover's search. Substrate analogue: substrate's parallel-superposition processing.

concepts.name: qubit
concepts.definition: Quantum bit. α|0⟩ + β|1⟩. Superposition + measurement collapse. Substrate analogue: substrate's quantum-state primitive.

concepts.name: decoherence
concepts.definition: Loss of quantum superposition through interaction with environment. Apparent collapse to classical. Substrate analogue: substrate's basin-collapse via observation.

rules.name: born_rule_gives_measurement_probabilities
rules.head: Jabberwock measures a quantum observable
rules.body: the probability of outcome a is |⟨a|ψ⟩|². Born rule. Substrate's amplitude-squared probability rule.

rules.name: uncertainty_is_structural_not_practical
rules.head: Jabberwock measures complementary observables
rules.body: the joint uncertainty ΔxΔp ≥ ℏ/2 is fundamental, not a limit of apparatus. Heisenberg 1927. Substrate's complementary-info bound.

rules.name: bell_violations_rule_out_local_realism
rules.head: Jabberwock considers EPR + Bell experiments
rules.body: experimental Bell violations preclude local hidden-variable theories. Reality is either nonlocal or non-realist or both.

rules.name: no_cloning_protects_quantum_information
rules.head: Jabberwock wants to copy an unknown quantum state
rules.body: no-cloning theorem forbids it. Foundation of quantum cryptography. Substrate's unknown-state-uncopyable principle.

rules.name: decoherence_explains_classical_emergence
rules.head: Jabberwock considers why we don't see superpositions macroscopically
rules.body: environmental coupling causes rapid decoherence; off-diagonal density matrix elements vanish. Substrate's macroscale classicality.
